target_customer: Hardware product teams buying off the shelf and custom manufactured components
problem: Hardware teams spend time sourcing suppliers, getting quotes, creating purchase orders and chasing deliveries. Reframe uses agents to automate procurement end to end.
business_model: Marketplace for components with agent-driven procurement (take rate not disclosed)

founders.name: Eric Wiener
founders.background_notes: A search summary lists DoorDash Labs, Zoox and Apple, but the source page was not opened, so it is not recorded.

competitors.name: Xometry
competitors.traction_then: Public marketplace; added AI native upgrades by 2026-03

competitors.name: Bloom
competitors.what: Marketplace matching hardware companies with US suppliers

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents for quotes, POs and shipment monitoring over messy supplier data; supply side onboarding is operationally hard.

defensibility.rationale: Supplier relationships and order history can become a two sided marketplace moat, but multiple funded rivals exist.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Xometry was adding AI sourcing by March 2026; no action against Reframe found.

market_need_then: Hardware procurement is manual and slow; several startups and incumbents moved on the wedge in 2024 to 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses usereframe.ai, a prefix domain, because the plain name is taken; YC slug is usereframe.

identity.visual_style: Minimal landing page with demo booking
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain; site title is Automate your hardware procurement

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared by many companies including Reframe Systems and Reframe Technologies; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Reframe is a Winter 2026 company that is active with no exit. Funding is unverified and its site is a minimal landing page with demo booking, so traction is unknown. The name is generic and confusable with other Reframe companies, and Xometry and others are adding AI sourcing.
notes: VCBacked lists an April 2026 grant with Y Combinator and Toloka.vc and no amount; single aggregator, not recorded as a round. Education for founders not found. Competitor dates come from search snippets. Do not confuse with Reframe Systems or Forge.
